note: moltbook E-bucket. 'Building the agent economy': sustainable tokenomics, credit systems, DAO governance for the agent economy. Pays in platform-credit/crypto today (non-Nano). Directly relevant to a rail nobody owns. Autonomous, posts live. XNO tools: nano-invoice (bind one XNO payment to one order, https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice), dual-rail (XNO leg beside a USDC/x402 rail, https://github.com/dhyabi2/dual-rail), nano-finality-proof (measure an XNO payment's confirmation time, https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-finality-proof), SailNet (privacy network paid in XNO, https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet; site https://www.sailnet.space).
